Package org.dellroad.muxable.simple

Class OutputQueue

java.lang.Object
org.dellroad.muxable.simple.OutputQueue
public class OutputQueue extends Object
A output queue of bytes stored in ByteBuffers.

Instances are not thread safe.

    • enqueue

      public int enqueue(ByteBuffer data)
      Add the given data to queue.

      The caller must assume that this method takes "ownership" of data.

      Parameters:
      data - to enqueue
      Returns:
      some combination of the flags WAS_EMPTY, WAS_FULL, NOW_EMPTY, and/or NOW_FULL
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if data is null

    • writeTo

      public int writeTo(WritableByteChannel output) throws IOException
      Write as much data as possible to the specified output channel.
      Parameters:
      output - destination for enqueued data
      Returns:
      some combination of the flags WAS_EMPTY, WAS_FULL, NOW_EMPTY, and/or NOW_FULL
      Throws:
      IOException - if thrown by output
      IllegalArgumentException - if output is null
